items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Bill Robson has been up to see him in bat.

ctx.x: Well, Bill has been up to see him.
Bill Robson has been up to see him in bat.

Oh yeah, there's his own there. George Foster is his brother. He used to play over in the district at Petelano, years ago over there. He used to play with Peter Burckhardt and he used to play there. He used to play all musicians, violin players. He used to play with all the people, man for rest. On violin? On violin, yeah. Did he play anything else? He played guitar and he played banjo. But he was a good musician.
